 Tar Heels in NBA: Caleb Wilson continues strong NBA start; RJ Davis in G League camp
 Posted Oct 27, 2026 
 Caleb Wilson ’s impressive start to his NBA career continued Monday, even as the Chicago Bulls endured their most lopsided loss of the young season on a day R.J. Davis joined a G League camp. The former Carolina star scored 17 points, grabbed five rebounds and contributed three assists, two blocks and a steal in Chicago’s 134-99 loss at Boston. 
( Tar Heel Tribune )
